links.comparator_used: Standard of care weekly clinical evaluations with ad hoc supplemental evaluations at clinician discretion, among ML-identified high-risk courses
links.outcome: Mean total adjusted medical costs during and 15 days after RT; acute care visits per course
links.effect: Adjusted costs $3110 (standard) vs $1494 (intervention), difference $1616 (95% CI $1450 to $1783; P=0.03); acute care visits 0.47 vs 0.31 (P=0.04)
links.tradeoff: Intervention group incurred supplemental visit costs of $155 per course (95% CI $142 to $168), which were more than offset by reduced acute care costs.
links.quote: In this economic analysis of a randomized controlled, health care ML study, mandatory supplemental evaluations for ML-identified high-risk patients were associated with both reduced total medical costs and improved clinical outcomes.

design_hint: mandatory supplemental clinical evaluations for high-risk patients
